# Templates (@specd/schema-std)

## Rules

### Proposal Template (`templates/proposal.md`)
- Required H2: `Motivation`, `Current behaviour`, `Proposed solution`, `Specs affected` (`New specs`/`Modified specs`), `Impact`, `Technical context`, `Open questions`
- Embed `<!-- ... -->` authoring guidance per section

### Specs Template (`templates/spec.md`)
- Title `# {{spec.name}}`; H2: `Purpose`, `Requirements` (`### Requirement: {{first requirement}}`), `Constraints`, `Spec Dependencies`
- Normative SHALL/MUST only; omit WHEN/THEN scenarios

### Verify Template (`templates/verify.md`)
- Title `# Verification: {{spec.name}}`; H2 `Requirements`
- Scenarios under `### Requirement: {{first requirement}}` + `#### Scenario: {{scenario name}}`
- Gherkin placeholders: `GIVEN`, `WHEN`, `THEN`, `AND/OR`

### Design Template (`templates/design.md`)
- Title `# Design: {{change.name}}`
- Sections: `Non-goals` (optional), `Affected areas`, `New constructs`, `Data models & Contracts`, `Approach & Execution flow`, `Error handling & Edge cases`, `Key decisions`, `Trade-offs`, `Spec impact`, `Dependency map` (Mermaid+ASCII), `Migration / Rollback`, `Testing`, `Open questions`
- Guidance: self-contained materialized contracts; no indirect refs

### Tasks Template (`templates/tasks.md`)
- Title `# Tasks: {{change.name}}`; groups `## 1. {{Phase or component name}}`
- Checklist `- [ ] <n>.<m> <description>` + indented file/symbol, `Approach:`, `(Req: ...)`

### Placeholders + Guidance Invariants
- Consistent vars `{{change.name}}`, `{{spec.name}}` + `<!-- ... -->` guidance
- MUST NOT hardcode project-specific logic

## Constraints
- All templates MUST be valid Markdown parseable by AST tools
- Templates MUST NOT duplicate sections or violate heading hierarchies
